summary: Eight-section soft-blue page: a split head with a team photo, a vision block with four numbered value cards, an "our people" block with country chips, a founder quote card, a ten-year journey with two video cards and a year-by-year slider, certification grid, partner marquee and a closing call-to-action card. Needs a team photo, a founder portrait, 8 to 10 milestones and about 10 certificates.

sections.note: soft pale-blue ground; eyebrow, large title, short lead and two buttons (one filled, one outlined) left; four team members cut out on the right edge
rounded photo left (a compass), heading with bold lead and two paragraphs right; below it four numbered value cards (01 to 04) with a small icon, title and paragraph
heading and paragraph with two flag chips left; a two by two grid of numbered cards with one sentence each right
one wide rounded card: round portrait with a white ring left, heading, quote mark, one quote and the founder name and title right

(measured as timeline) centered heading and lead; two video cards (poster, caption); then a rounded panel titled milestones with a stepper of year ranges on top and a sliding row of cards each with photo, year, title and text, arrows at both ends
centered heading and paragraph; grid of ten badges in two rows of five with a caption under each
heading and a scrolling row of partner and chamber logos
rounded light card: heading, one sentence and a white pill button left; a smiling headset photo fading in from the right
